scripts.lint: biome check . && pnpm run lint:worker && bash scripts/check-boundaries.sh
scripts.lint:worker: cd apps/agent-worker && uv run --frozen ruff check . ../../scripts && uv run --frozen ruff format --check . ../../scripts
scripts.format: biome check --write . && cd apps/agent-worker && uv run --frozen ruff format . ../../scripts && uv run --frozen ruff check --fix --quiet . ../../scripts
scripts.test: pnpm -r --if-present test && pnpm run test:worker && pnpm run test:scripts
scripts.test:worker: cd apps/agent-worker && uv run --frozen pytest -q && uv run --frozen python scripts/check_coverage.py
scripts.replay: cd apps/agent-worker && uv run --frozen python -m replay
scripts.replay:live: cd apps/agent-worker && uv run --frozen --env-file ../../.env python -m replay --live
scripts.stt:live: cd apps/agent-worker && uv run --frozen --env-file ../../.env python -m replay.stt_live
scripts.gen: pnpm --filter @sotto/shared gen && cd apps/agent-worker && uv run --frozen python scripts/gen_card_model.py
